SELECT ac.id, ac.mal_id, ac.anilist_id, ac.name, ac.name_jp, ac.image_url, ac.favorites, ufc.favorite_status AS isLiked, ufc.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_favorite_character ufc INNER JOIN anime_character ac ON ufc.character_id = ac.id WHERE ufc.user_id = #{userId} AND ufc.favorite_status = 1
AND (ac.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') OR ac.name_jp LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%'))
ORDER BY ufc.updated_at DESC
